title: Idolobha Elalikholelwa Esikhathini
intro: Ezindabeni zesihe saphezulu, kunomphakathi oguquko lwawo lwaba umzuzu wokugcwaliseka kwezwe lonke. Usuzokwembula indaba yabo—indaba yesixwayiso, ukuphenduka, kanye nokuphumula okubahlukanisa nesiphetho sezinye izizwe.
clues: Sasingabantu ababethunywe isithunywa kubo, futhi sayeka ukubizwa kwakhe ekuqaleni.
Lapho izimpawu zesijeziso esisondelayo sezicaca, saqaphela iqiniso lesixwayiso sakhe.
Saphendukela eNkosini yethu ngokuphenduka okuqotho, futhi ukholo lwethu lwamukelwa.
Isijeziso esasinqunyiwe kithi sasuswa ngenxa yokholo lwethu.
Indaba yethu ibizwa ngokuthi ihlukile phakathi kwamadolobha akholwa ngemva kokubona isijeziso.
Sasingabantu bomprofethi owagwinywa ngumkhomo, kodwa sasindiswa ekubhujisweni.
verse: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time. (37:148)
